items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He and Pete Rugolo went from San Francisco State

ctx.x: After the war, you decide to go to Mills College. What determined that decision? Why did you decide to go to Mills?

My brother was studying with [Darius] Milhaud. He and Pete Rugolo went from San Francisco State [College] to Mills to get their masters degrees. They would be some of the first males to attend Mills. They allowed it on masters degree programs. It was through Howard that I heard about Milhaud. While I was still a student at Pacific, I hitch-hiked down to Mills to meet with Milhaud. He said – I knew I was going into the Army. It’s often said I was drafted. I wasn’t drafted. I enlisted by telling the draft office…
So you actually enlisted rather than . . .
